paragraphs: REI sells camera systems, fleet management software, video monitors, radios and accessories for transportation fleets. The company's in-house engineers create fleet camera systems and collision avoidance systems for trucks, buses, or commercial vehicles.

The homepage lists the markets served as School Bus, Motorcoach, Transit, Commercial Bus, Commercial Truck, and Agriculture & Construction. Support staff handle questions about school bus, transit bus, and commercial vehicle fleet camera systems and management software.

The about page describes REI as an engineering company focused on hardware and software for transportation, including 360 surround view cameras and driver assistance for school bus, transit, motorcoach and commercial vehicle fleets. A testimonial on the homepage is credited to a Director of Transportation at a school district.
